assertions: Original resize delegates to actual resize_impl; same size is a no-op, zero calls original clear, and growth appends empty cells with source metadata/logical size ordering.

Original append_empty creates initial empty metadata, extends an empty tail or appends a new empty block after nonempty data and returns the original new-block flag. push_back_empty uses that flag to return the actual last block iterator.

Original truncation locates the new end, preserves the exact new_end_row+1 overwrite argument and shortened count, invokes actual scalar resize, updates retained metadata, releases/deletes every lower nonnull block in original order, erases metadata and updates logical size last.

All350 prior complete native ownership/query/navigation sequences and their final events remain unchanged; appended resize/empty-push cases retain every full owner/event/payload/capacity/result/error/equality/endpoint state.

stackDivergence.rationale: Original owner member algorithms and private fields preserved; existing metadata, block search, deletion, typed funcs and iterator owners reused, no new resize engine or upstream correction.

record.capability: Shared original SoA resize and empty-tail growth contracts
gaps: Selected pinned libc++ size_t64 no_trace/default-execution with initialized all12 unmanaged standard scalar families and nonthrowing original event value witnesses. Exact bounded metadata/payload capacity, size/tail/block-edge changes, copy isolation and original overwrite/resize/release/delete arguments/order are compared using forwarding actual standard funcs, not alternate algorithms. Moved-source same-size, shrinking diagnostic and clear are admitted; growth with empty moved metadata/nonzero logical size violates original assert and is excluded. Full managed/custom block outcomes, throwing allocation/events, native ABI/qualifiers, invalid pointers/hints/ranges/overflow/unbounded size_t and arbitrary values remain unverified. Remaining set/transfer/erase/insert groups, trace/debug/SIMD, whole Calc columns/documents/browser and complete module/default/QA certification remain gaps. Original global overwrite offset is preserved and documented, not normalized.
